body: Several European airlines including Ryanair, Wizz Air, LOT Polish Airlines and Scandinavian Airlines (SAS) were targeted by a series of bomb threats within hours of each other on November 3, 2026. LOT Polish Airlines confirmed that a Boeing 737 MAX 8 departed London-Heathrow at 06:43 for Warsaw Chopin but was forced to divert to Warsaw Modlin due to a threat. LOT told AeroTime it was notified by airport authorities of a potential security threat on board, and that once the aircraft landed it taxied to a designated parking stand and underwent a security inspection.

The LOT spokesperson said: “The aircraft security inspection has been completed, with no suspicious items found.” After border control checks, passengers were transferred to Warsaw Chopin Airport (WAW) by coach. An SAS Airbus A320neo that departed Copenhagen just before 08:30 for Warsaw Chopin was also the subject of a threat; it landed normally in Warsaw and the passengers disembarked. SAS said it was following established security procedures, adding: “The matter is now being handled by the police in Warsaw, and we are following their instructions.”

Spanish authorities confirmed a bomb threat against a flight from Manchester to Murcia Corvera Airport (RMU); 114 passengers and seven crew members disembarked, and police later ruled out the presence of explosives on the plane. According to Flightradar24 data cited by AeroTime, the only airline to arrive at Murcia Corvera from Manchester that day was a Ryanair Boeing 737 MAX 8-200. The BBC reported that sources at Rome Fiumicino (FCO) Airport said two Ryanair flights arriving from Lisbon and Dublin were checked over potential bomb threats. Wizz Air confirmed its Milan Bergamo–Sofia flight W6 4352 was subject to a bomb threat communicated by the Bulgarian authorities; as the aircraft was already approaching its destination, no diversion was necessary and it landed safely at Sofia, where checks cleared the aircraft. The Bulgarian News Agency said Transport Minister Peev told reporters that bomb threats were received for two aircraft headed for Sofia, including the Wizz Air flight and another from Dublin.
en.summary: Ryanair, Wizz Air, LOT Polish Airlines and SAS aircraft were targeted by a series of bomb threats within hours on November 3, 2026. A LOT flight diverted, an SAS flight landed normally, and checks found no explosives on the aircraft inspected.
en.title: Bomb threats target Ryanair, Wizz Air, LOT and SAS flights within hours

facts.claim: On November 3, 2026, Ryanair, Wizz Air, LOT Polish Airlines and SAS were targeted by a series of bomb threats within hours of each other.

A LOT Boeing 737 MAX 8 that departed London-Heathrow at 06:43 for Warsaw Chopin diverted to Warsaw Modlin after a threat; its security inspection found no suspicious items, and passengers were transferred to Warsaw Chopin by coach.
An SAS Airbus A320neo that departed Copenhagen just before 08:30 for Warsaw Chopin was also threatened; it landed normally in Warsaw and the matter is being handled by police in Warsaw.
A flight from Manchester to Murcia Corvera Airport was threatened; 114 passengers and seven crew were disembarked and police later ruled out the presence of explosives.
Wizz Air flight W6 4352 from Milan Bergamo to Sofia was subject to a bomb threat; it landed safely at Sofia with no diversion and was cleared after security checks.
Two Ryanair flights arriving at Rome Fiumicino from Lisbon and Dublin were checked over potential bomb threats, according to BBC-cited airport sources.

body: 2026年11月3日數小時內，瑞安航空、維茲航空、波蘭航空與北歐航空的航班接連成為炸彈威脅目標。波蘭航空證實，一架波音737 MAX 8於06:43自倫敦希斯洛機場（LHR）起飛前往華沙蕭邦機場，因接獲威脅改降華沙莫德林機場。波蘭航空向AeroTime表示，機場當局通知機上有潛在安全威脅，飛機落地後滑行至指定停機位接受安全檢查。
波蘭航空發言人表示：「飛機安全檢查已經完成，未發現可疑物品。」旅客通過邊境檢查後，由巴士轉送至華沙蕭邦機場。北歐航空一架空中巴士A320neo於08:30前自哥本哈根起飛前往華沙蕭邦機場，同樣成為威脅目標，班機正常降落華沙，旅客下機。北歐航空表示正遵循既定安全程序，並說：「此事現由華沙警方處理，我們正遵照其指示。」

西班牙當局證實，一架自曼徹斯特飛往穆爾西亞科爾韋拉機場的航班接獲炸彈威脅，114名旅客與7名機組人員下機，警方檢查後排除機上有爆炸物。據AeroTime引述的Flightradar24資料，當天自曼徹斯特抵達穆爾西亞科爾韋拉機場的航空公司僅有瑞安航空一架波音737 MAX 8-200。英國廣播公司（BBC）報導，羅馬菲烏米奇諾機場消息人士稱，兩架分別自里斯本與都柏林抵達的瑞安航空航班也因潛在炸彈威脅接受檢查。維茲航空證實，當天米蘭貝加莫飛往索菲亞的W6 4352航班接獲炸彈威脅，由保加利亞當局通報航空公司；由於飛機已接近目的地，無須轉降，安全降落索菲亞機場（SOF），檢查後放行。保加利亞通訊社稱，交通部長Peev向記者表示，飛往索菲亞的兩架飛機接獲炸彈威脅，包括該維茲航空航班與另一架自都柏林出發的飛機。
zh.summary: 2026年11月3日數小時內，瑞安航空、維茲航空、波蘭航空與北歐航空的航班接連成為炸彈威脅目標。波蘭航空一班客機轉降，北歐航空班機正常降落，受檢飛機均未發現可疑物品。
zh.title: 瑞安航空、維茲航空、波蘭航空與北歐航空航班同日連環接獲炸彈威脅
